RA11223 section5 establishes automatic NHIP inclusion. Current coverage included/verify and primary-care provider sections distinguish inclusion from clinic selection/registration. Keep both concepts; do not replace statutory inclusion with registration-required membership.

RA11223 section4(s) permits a qualifying worker or institution. Active T06 assesses referral process, not the old definition question. An RHU-only or place-only answer would be narrower than the law. Clarify terminology in a versioned item/teaching proposal; do not rewrite historical attempts.
